info.title: CartCloser AI API
info.description: Consent-based abandoned-checkout recovery. DEMO tenant UrbanThread PK is fictional. Messaging is simulated; Shopify/WooCommerce/WhatsApp are not connected.

get.description: Recovery deep link: a signed token instead of shopper auth. Opening it is NOT counted as recovery.

schema.title: Response Post Message Conversations  Cart Id  Messages Post

post.description: Either the shopper (X-Shopper-Id) or a valid recovery-link token must authorize the order.

get.description: Data export for the tenant (no payment data exists; phones are masked).

delete.description: Erase a shopper's carts, messages and consent records (orders are kept anonymised for accounting).

get.description: Server-sent events: emits {"version": n} whenever demo data changes. Clients then refetch.
Polling fallback for live updates: returns the change-feed version.

post.description: Run one scheduler tick now (the background scheduler also runs every second).

affirmative.title: Affirmative
affirmative.description: Must be true: consent is an explicit affirmative action

recovery_token.title: Recovery Token
recovery_token.description: Present when the order came from a recovery link
